filter: ParcelNum <> '-99999' AND ACCOUNTNO IS NOT NULL AND Shape__Area > 5 * Shape__Length AND CalcAcres < 1000
notes: County ArcGIS Online parcels (State Plane CO South ft source, 18,159 features). KNOWN LIMITATION: source has invalid (self-overlapping/multi-part) geometry on many large parcels. Filter keeps only rows with a tax account number, drops placeholder ParcelNum -99999 rows and zero-width sliver polygons (area < 5 x perimeter), and drops parcels >= 1000 acres, which are the ones with invalid geometry; large ranch parcels are therefore missing. Situs address is almost empty in source so address is not mapped.
